svg.title: Coulomb forces between two point charges
svg.desc: The force between point charges q1 and q2 a distance r apart. (a) Two negative charges repel: F21 on q1 points away from q2, and F12 on q2 points away from q1. (b) A negative q1 and a positive q2 attract: the forces point toward each other. In each case the two forces are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, as Newton’s third law requires. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Coulomb force falls with the square of separation
